items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Jack Kerry was doing it. See, he had the band. He was paying us nice, see.

ctx.x: And you also played at what, the National Park or Third and Wall? National Park, yeah.

You know all. That was Third and Willow. It's a school there now, big school. But it used to be a great big baseball park, see. And we didn't have nothing but a little shit over us. What did you play? Concerts or for dances? Dancers. For dances, huh? Yeah. She'd be loaded at them. Well, who would pay you for that? Well, Jack Kerry was doing it. See, he had the band. He was paying us nice, see. Shills, I, I, he wouldn't lie because he was so kind of dumb himself. And he couldn't do nothing but come clean, see. And…
Well, how far away could they hear you when you were at 3rd and Willow?
